title: (fix) O3-6027: Clear order and diagnosis submissions on every write
body:

## Summary

The orders and diagnosis adapters now clear the field's submission at the start of `transformFieldValue`, the same way `ObsAdapter` already does.

Before this, a value from an earlier write stayed on the field after it was cleared, because `gracefullySetSubmission` only sets values and never clears them. On a new encounter, if you selected an order or diagnosis and then cleared the field, it still went out with the encounter. On an edited encounter, if you swapped a saved order or diagnosis for another value and then cleared the field, the swapped value still went out. For orders that meant a `NEW` order alongside the void. For diagnoses it meant the saved diagnosis got edited to the swapped concept instead of being voided. Now nothing is submitted for a new encounter, and only the void goes out for an edited one.

`editOrder` no longer calls `clearSubmission` itself when the value matches the saved order, since the submission is already empty by then.

I found this while working on #822. It's the reason a swap followed by a clear still keeps the saved order or diagnosis when the field is hidden there. With both merged, that case voids it like any other cleared value.
